summary: Evofem Biosciences filed an 8-K on September 23, 2026, disclosing a Manufacturing Agreement dated September 17, 2026, with Zhaoke (Hong Kong) Ophthalmology Pharmaceutical Limited and Zhaoke (Guangzhou) Ophthalmology Pharmaceutical Co. Ltd., under which Zhaoke will manufacture and supply PHEXX (lactic acid, citric acid, potassium bitartrate). The registrant is acting as Buyer; no stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, ownership split, or regulatory clock is stated. This is an ordinary supply/manufacturing contract, not a special situation, so the deal-term object is empty and no risk-arb angle applies.
